review_evidence: CwF.v: Defines Categories with Families as a bicategory (disp_cwf, cwf) with univalence proofs (cwf_is_univalent_2_1, cwf_is_univalent_2_0, cwf_is_univalent_2)
CategoryRXGraph.v: Defines reflexive graphs of categories (precategory_data_rxgraph, category_rxgraph) and proves weq_category_paths_to_catiso and is_univalent_category_rxgraph
Functors.v: Core functor definitions (fully_faithful, conservative, essentially_surjective, faithful, full, pseudomonic) with 100+ lemmas about their properties
Core.v: Defines unital magmoids with linearity/thunkability/polarization (is_linear, is_thunkable, is_intermediate, is_positive, is_negative) and associativity lemmas
Functors.v (UnitalMagmoids): Defines preservation/reflection of submagmoids (preserves_submm, reflects_submm) and weak/strong equivalences (submm_weak_equiv, submm_strong_equiv)
Isos.v: Defines isomorphisms in submagmoids (has_submm_inverse, is_submm_iso, submm_iso, subcat_iso) with composition lemmas
Opposite.v: Defines opposite magmoids (opp_premagmoid, opp_magmoid) with definitional dualities (is_linear ↔ is_thunkable, is_positive ↔ is_negative)
PolarizedSubcategories.v: Defines polarized subcategories (isc_linear, isc_thunkable, positive_category, negative_category) and inclusion functors with faithfulness proofs
Submagmoids.v: General theory of wide submagmoids (wide_submagmoid, wide_subcategory, submm_includes) with carrier constructions and functor inclusions
Tactics.v: Provides submagmoid tactic and hint database for inferring polarity properties
Univalence.v: Defines univalence for unital magmoids (is_um_univalent) and proves univalent magmoids form a univalent type
PartA.v: General lemmas on paths/transport/h-levels/surjectivity (maponpaths variants, transportf lemmas, hfp lemmas, issurjective lemmas)
